title: The Most Overlooked $13K/Day Business Anyone Can Start
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Guest mentions upcoming paid online guides and in-person training for line striping

idea.name: Parking lot line striping via cold email to churches
idea.one_liner: Stripe parking lots at ~$5/line using a used Graco striper, landing church and business lots via purchased-lead cold emails and a local Facebook giveaway
idea.customer: churches and businesses with parking lots
idea.offer: parking line restriping, stencils (handicap, arrows, fire lanes)

key_quotes.quote: So, I went on Facebook, made a post in our town's page, and just said, "Hey, I'd love to help out a business.
So email I I work with a guy overseas just on Upwork found him and I pay him five or six bucks for a list that he provides.
So the email just says hey I'm new to this. I will give you a good price.

claims.claim: Took home just under $20k profit that month
claims.quote: So, I I went home with just under 20 in profit.
Yeah, so you're looking at conservatively $200 in cost or $550 in profit.
What is your close rate? Um it's like 40 to 50%.
So, so I I started this business with uh just over $3,000, but then I I did buy some more equipment during this those two months.

acquisition_channels.details: ~300 manual emails to scraped church/business lists bought for $5-6 from Upwork freelancer
planned yard signs and branded barricades

ideas.delivery: owner-operator with Graco LineLazer, subcontracts/hires helpers in peaks; quotes from satellite imagery
ideas.other_uk_rules: PECR: cold email to sole traders/unincorporated bodies (many churches) needs consent; corporate subscribers OK with opt-out. Public highway markings fall under TSRGD 2016.

stated_problem.quote: But everyone wanted a seal coating quote as well.
stated_problem.speaker: Hunter

idea.name: Parking lot seal coating
idea.one_liner: Spray asphalt sealer from a towed 275-gallon tank at 15-25c/sq ft against ~6c material cost, upsold to striping customers
idea.revenue_model: per-square-foot pricing; 50% deposit, balance on completion

key_quotes.quote: So, yeah, it could be like a 50% net profit job even if you don't do it yourself.
So in this industry, there's just like there's way more people that want to pay for it than there are people doing the work like you are.

claims.quote: We've had some some jobs that lasted longer, but for a one-day seal coating job, it was uh it was 13,000.
For this job? Yeah, so where where I get it from my asphalt supplier, um it's about 6 cents a square foot.
So we we did one job that was 26,000.

ideas.delivery: crew of two at ~$25-30/hour; used trailer, tank and pump

tools: 275-gallon sealer tank trailer with spray pump

ideas.other_uk_rules: Coal-tar based sealers are hazardous; COSHH assessment needed

idea.name: Parking lot crack filling
idea.one_liner: Hot-pour crack filling priced by the linear foot with ~70% gross margin, sold alongside striping and sealing

key_quotes.quote: I drove 3 hours to go pick up a machine, spend another 1,500 bucks on it.
But I I did a job I worked for 2 days. I walked away with nothing.

claims.quote: No, no. I I think I think the smallest crack filling job I had was over 400.
